name: Dorothy Charles
reason: Her work is Relational Gestalt Practice, a group form of Gestalt therapy in the Richard Price lineage built on open-seat sessions with her (her site calls it education, but its stated focus is emotional patterns from trauma, loss and early relationships, and it is aimed partly at the helping professions), so it falls under the therapy rule; it is also thin, with no books, no free resources and no channel of her own (only short Esalen clips and a history talk), and her one non-Esalen programme for 2027 has no dates or venue yet. Her Esalen programmes (27 Nov to 4 Dec 2026, 22 to 26 Feb 2027, 10 to 14 May 2027) are current.
